title: Supply of Furniture items for the inspection quarters of Olakuda Lighthouse under Chennai directorate
summary: Offline sealed quotation for supply of two teak wood single cots and two coir mattresses for the inspection quarters of Olakuda Lighthouse, Rameshwaram, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Olakuda Lighthouse, Olakuda Village, Rameshwaram, Ramanathapuram Dist, Tamilnadu-623526 (inspection quarters)
sites.work: Supply of furniture for inspection quarters

scope.item: Supply of teak wood single cot, size 6 1/4' x 3', inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding and freight up to Olakuda Lighthouse
Supply of coir mattress (reputed make), size 6 1/4' x 3' x 4" thickness, for single cot, inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding and freight up to Olakuda Lighthouse

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value as PBG/FDR from commercial banks, valid 60 days beyond warranty period; released after 1 year warranty
money.notes: No estimated cost or EMD printed. Payment on final account basis after satisfactory supply to delivery location.

period.completion: 15 days from date of supply order
period.warranty: 1 year against manufacturing defects for all wooden items

eligibility: Similar work in last seven years ending 31 March 2025: one work >= Rs 79,840, or two >= Rs 49,900 each, or three >= Rs 39,920 each
Similar work: supply of office furniture items in Central Govt./State Govt./public listed/PSUs; completion certificates from officer not below Manager/AEE/Administrative Officer, with PO or GeM CRAC
Non-blacklisting affidavit on firm letterhead for last 3 years
Valid registration and office address in Tamilnadu/Puducherry (MSME certificate or business registration)
Detailed technical specifications of items as per Annexure A
specs: Teak wood single cot 6.25' x 3' with coir mattress; design as per photo in Annexure C
Stage inspection by DLL Chennai representative before polishing/varnishing and before supply
notes: Scanned 5-page NIQ: notice, Annexure A schedule (no rates), Annexure B terms, Annexure C photo. Annexure C caption gives mattress as 6.25' x 3' x 4' (feet) whereas schedule says 4" thickness. Directorate e-mail printed is a gmail address used as office mail.
